CustomField.description: Exibe os tempos de pouso do voe omni e sig caso sejam diferentes
CustomField.formula: IF(AND(ISNULL(Pouso__c), ISNULL(PousoSig__c)), '', IF(OR(Pouso__c != PousoSig__c, ISNULL(Pouso__c), ISNULL(PousoSig__c)), IF(ISNULL(Pouso__c), '-', 'OMNI: ' & RIGHT(LEFT(TEXT(Pouso__c),16),5)) & ' / ' & IF(ISNULL(PousoSig__c), '-', 'Sig: ' & RIGHT(LEFT(TEXT(PousoSig__c),16),5)), ''))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Exibe os tempos de pouso do voe omni e sig caso sejam diferentes
CustomField.label: Pouso Dif
